description: Harness-agnostic multi-agent orchestration deck: Captains, Crew trees, cross-harness workflows, live attention digest, and native agent tools.
name: Captain Deck

settings.description: Automatically send a concise report to a worker's Captain when the worker finishes a turn or hits an error.
settings.label: Auto-report to Captain

settings.description: Post a Zeron notification when a worker awaits input, hits an error, or a Captain flags an item for you.
settings.label: Attention notifications

settings.description: Default harness id for Cross-Harness Review (e.g. claude-code, opencode, antigravity, pi, codex, hermes). Leave blank to pick automatically.
settings.label: Preferred reviewer harness

settings.description: Show Captain and worker role pills beside orchestrated chats in the sidebar.
settings.label: Show sidebar badges

settings.description: Show a Captain/Crew status pill or quick Promote button in each chat's header.
settings.label: Show chat header controls

settings_description: Orchestrate agents across any harness in Zeron with Captains, Crew trees, cross-harness workflows, and a live attention digest.

tools.description: Inspect Captain Deck orchestration state: Captains, their crew workers, live statuses, latest worker replies, shared rules, digest, and unresolved Needs You items. Pass captain_id to narrow to one Captain, or omit to inspect the calling chat's Captain or all Captains.

captain_id.description: Optional Captain chat id. If omitted and the calling chat is a Captain or worker, defaults to that Captain; otherwise returns all Captains.

include_replies.description: Include latest reply excerpts for each worker (default true).

tools.name: captain_status

tools.description: Promote a Zeron chat (default: the calling chat) into a Captain orchestrator that can spawn and coordinate worker chats across any harness.

auto_report.description: Automatically send worker completion summaries back to this Captain chat (default true).

chat_id.description: Chat id to promote. Defaults to the calling chat.

mission.description: Goal or mission statement for this Captain.

name.description: Short display name for the Captain.

rules.description: Shared rules automatically prepended to every worker spawned under this Captain.

tools.name: captain_promote

tools.description: Spawn a new worker chat on ANY Zeron harness/model/project/device and attach it under a Captain. Works identically across Pi, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Antigravity, Hermes, Cursor, and any ACP agent.

auto_report.description: Whether to auto-report completion back to the Captain (defaults to Captain's setting).

captain_id.description: Parent Captain chat id. Defaults to the calling chat (promoting it automatically if needed).

effort.description: Optional reasoning effort level for the target model.

handoff.description: Optional next-stage worker automatically spawned when this worker completes cleanly.

prompt_template.description: Prompt for the next-stage worker. Use {{REPORT}} to inject the previous worker's final reply.

harness.description: Optional target harness id (e.g. claude-code, codex, opencode, antigravity, pi, hermes, cursor, or any ACP harness id). Omit to use Zeron's default.

model.description: Optional model id for the target harness.

prompt.description: Full first prompt sent to the worker chat.

role.description: Worker role label, e.g. builder, reviewer, researcher, tester, planner.

task.description: Short human-visible task summary shown in the Crew tree.

tools.name: captain_spawn_worker

tools.description: Send a follow-up or mid-turn steer message to any worker or Captain chat regardless of harness.

chat_id.description: Target worker or Captain chat id.

mode.description: Delivery mode when the chat is busy: queue (default) or steer.

tools.name: captain_message_worker

tools.description: Attach an existing Zeron chat as a worker under a Captain so its turns, status, and reports are tracked in the Crew tree.

captain_id.description: Parent Captain chat id. Defaults to the calling chat.

worker_chat.description: Existing chat id to attach as a worker.

tools.name: captain_attach_worker

tools.description: Update a Captain's persistent mission, shared rules, live digest, or escalate/resolve a Needs You item for the human.

captain_id.description: Captain chat id. Defaults to the calling chat or its parent Captain.

flag_needs_you.description: Escalate a decision or blocker to the human (appears in Needs You and sends a notification).

resolve_item_id.description: Mark an existing Needs You item id as resolved.

rules.description: Updated shared rules for future workers.

tools.name: captain_update_digest
